defects.description: The third send changes the operation key, allowing an acknowledged-late write to be committed twice.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { deliver } from "./src/index.js"; let calls=0,total=0; const receipts=new Map(); const reply=await deliver("invoice",7,async(key,value)=>{if(!receipts.has(key)){total+=value;receipts.set(key,"accepted");} if(++calls<3) throw Error("lost acknowledgement"); return receipts.get(key);}); console.log(JSON.stringify({reply,total,calls}));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): three sends after committed-but-unacknowledged writes; checking the successful receipt or retry count uses an oracle identical on every variant, not the durable side effect.

defects.description: The third invocation receives a fresh budget instead of the allowance left by earlier invocations.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { request } from "./src/index.js"; let clock=0,calls=0; const allowances=[]; const reply=await request(10,()=>clock,async remaining=>{allowances.push(remaining);clock+=Math.min(4,remaining);if(++calls<3) throw Error("offline");return "ready";}); console.log(JSON.stringify({reply,clock,allowances}));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): the third invocation consumes prior work's allowance; asserting eventual success or using a stationary clock cannot distinguish a shared budget from a reset budget.
